finance_expenses_order_required_chk.name: finance_expenses_order_required_chk
finance_expenses_order_required_chk.value: "finance_expenses"."category" not in ('return_shipping_cost', 'return_handling') or "finance_expenses"."order_id" is not null

finance_expenses_order_forbidden_chk.name: finance_expenses_order_forbidden_chk
finance_expenses_order_forbidden_chk.value: "finance_expenses"."category" not in ('advertising', 'partner_fixed_fee', 'salaries', 'rent', 'services', 'bank_fees', 'taxes_company', 'fx_difference', 'other_income', 'inventory_loss') or ("finance_expenses"."order_id" is null and "finance_expenses"."return_id" is null)

finance_expenses_return_chk.name: finance_expenses_return_chk
finance_expenses_return_chk.value: "finance_expenses"."return_id" is null or "finance_expenses"."order_id" is not null

finance_expenses_date_chk.name: finance_expenses_date_chk
finance_expenses_date_chk.value: ("finance_expenses"."expense_date" is not null) or ("finance_expenses"."period_from" is not null and "finance_expenses"."period_to" is not null)

finance_expenses_period_chk.name: finance_expenses_period_chk
finance_expenses_period_chk.value: ("finance_expenses"."period_from" is null) = ("finance_expenses"."period_to" is null) and ("finance_expenses"."period_from" is null or ("finance_expenses"."period_from" <= "finance_expenses"."period_to" and "finance_expenses"."period_to" - "finance_expenses"."period_from" < 366))

finance_expenses_forecast_chk.name: finance_expenses_forecast_chk
finance_expenses_forecast_chk.value: not ("finance_expenses"."covers_forecast" and "finance_expenses"."separate_from_forecast") and (not "finance_expenses"."separate_from_forecast" or "finance_expenses"."separate_reason" is not null)

finance_fee_rules_fixed_chk.name: finance_fee_rules_fixed_chk
finance_fee_rules_fixed_chk.value: ("finance_fee_rules"."fixed_amount" is null) = ("finance_fee_rules"."fixed_currency" is null) and ("finance_fee_rules"."fixed_amount" is null or "finance_fee_rules"."fixed_amount" >= 0)

inventory_cost_layers_pending_chk.name: inventory_cost_layers_pending_chk
inventory_cost_layers_pending_chk.value: ("inventory_cost_layers"."pending_unit_cost" is null) = ("inventory_cost_layers"."pending_currency" is null) and ("inventory_cost_layers"."pending_unit_cost" is null or "inventory_cost_layers"."pending_unit_cost" >= 0)

inventory_movements_cost_chk.name: inventory_movements_cost_chk
inventory_movements_cost_chk.value: "inventory_movements"."unit_cost" is null or ("inventory_movements"."unit_cost" >= 0 and "inventory_movements"."cost_currency" is not null)

order_disputes_amounts_chk.name: order_disputes_amounts_chk
order_disputes_amounts_chk.value: ("order_disputes"."amount" is null or "order_disputes"."amount" >= 0) and ("order_disputes"."recovered_amount" is null or "order_disputes"."recovered_amount" >= 0) and ("order_disputes"."fee" is null or "order_disputes"."fee" >= 0)

order_finance_recognized_chk.name: order_finance_recognized_chk
order_finance_recognized_chk.value: ("order_finance"."state" <> 'recognized' or "order_finance"."recognized_on" is not null) and ("order_finance"."recognized_on" is null) = ("order_finance"."recognized_at" is null)

order_packing_parcel_chk.name: order_packing_parcel_chk
order_packing_parcel_chk.value:
("order_packing"."parcel_weight_grams" is null or "order_packing"."parcel_weight_grams" > 0)
        and ("order_packing"."parcel_length_mm" is null or "order_packing"."parcel_length_mm" > 0)
        and ("order_packing"."parcel_width_mm" is null or "order_packing"."parcel_width_mm" > 0)
        and ("order_packing"."parcel_height_mm" is null or "order_packing"."parcel_height_mm" > 0)

orders_parcel_override_chk.name: orders_parcel_override_chk
orders_parcel_override_chk.value:
("orders"."parcel_weight_grams" is null or "orders"."parcel_weight_grams" > 0)
        and ("orders"."parcel_length_mm" is null or "orders"."parcel_length_mm" > 0)
        and ("orders"."parcel_width_mm" is null or "orders"."parcel_width_mm" > 0)
        and ("orders"."parcel_height_mm" is null or "orders"."parcel_height_mm" > 0)

packaging_materials_dims_chk.name: packaging_materials_dims_chk
packaging_materials_dims_chk.value:
("packaging_materials"."inner_length_mm" is null or "packaging_materials"."inner_length_mm" > 0)
        and ("packaging_materials"."inner_width_mm" is null or "packaging_materials"."inner_width_mm" > 0)
        and ("packaging_materials"."inner_height_mm" is null or "packaging_materials"."inner_height_mm" > 0)
        and ("packaging_materials"."max_weight_grams" is null or "packaging_materials"."max_weight_grams" > 0)
        and ("packaging_materials"."tare_weight_grams" is null or "packaging_materials"."tare_weight_grams" >= 0)

packaging_materials_cost_chk.name: packaging_materials_cost_chk
packaging_materials_cost_chk.value: "packaging_materials"."unit_cost" is null or ("packaging_materials"."unit_cost" >= 0 and "packaging_materials"."cost_currency" is not null)

partner_attributions_attributed_chk.name: partner_attributions_attributed_chk
partner_attributions_attributed_chk.value: "partner_attributions"."status" <> 'attributed' or ("partner_attributions"."partner_id" is not null and "partner_attributions"."rate_bp" is not null and "partner_attributions"."hold_days" is not null)

partner_codes_validity_chk.name: partner_codes_validity_chk
partner_codes_validity_chk.value: "partner_codes"."valid_from" is null or "partner_codes"."valid_to" is null or "partner_codes"."valid_from" <= "partner_codes"."valid_to"

production_batch_lines_cost_chk.name: production_batch_lines_cost_chk
production_batch_lines_cost_chk.value: "production_batch_lines"."unit_cost" is null or ("production_batch_lines"."unit_cost" >= 0 and "production_batch_lines"."cost_currency" is not null)

production_batches_cost_chk.name: production_batches_cost_chk
production_batches_cost_chk.value: "production_batches"."extra_cost" is null or ("production_batches"."extra_cost" >= 0 and "production_batches"."cost_currency" is not null)

shipping_forecast_snapshots_amount_chk.name: shipping_forecast_snapshots_amount_chk
shipping_forecast_snapshots_amount_chk.value: ("shipping_forecast_snapshots"."basis" = 'none') = ("shipping_forecast_snapshots"."amount" is null) and ("shipping_forecast_snapshots"."amount" is null) = ("shipping_forecast_snapshots"."currency" is null)

stock_items_kind_chk.name: stock_items_kind_chk
stock_items_kind_chk.value:
("stock_items"."kind" = 'product' and "stock_items"."variant_id" is not null and "stock_items"."material_id" is null)
        or ("stock_items"."kind" = 'material' and "stock_items"."material_id" is not null and "stock_items"."variant_id" is null)
